description: Modern typed .NET client for the DK Plus v1 and v2 APIs.
releaseNotes: v0.7.0: every DK Plus model declares its identity with the new DevOp.ERP.Abstractions attributes: the DkPlus subtypes inherit the portable key and declare their typed RecordId with [ErpRecordId]; NationEntry and MyPagesInvite keys are marked as personal data; GeneralLedgerAccount and GeneralLedgerTaxGroup key on Number, Warehouse on Code, ProjectJournal, WebhookSubscription and TokenCompanyAccess on Id; transactions, lines, log entries, metadata, and records whose number is unique only within a parent (CustomerContact and CustomerReceiver within their customer, ProjectPhase, ProjectTask, WorkRequest) declare no key. Read them through ErpIdentity. The required identity on read, the skipping of product, customer and vendor list rows without one, the identity a projection always includes, and the identity names of the unreadable-numeric-value rule now come from these declarations; behaviour, log output and projections are unchanged. Additive and binary-compatible. v0.6.1: an optional numeric value in a DK Plus response that cannot be read no longer fails the whole read with DkPlusContractException. DK Plus returned a product UnitPrice1 of 1.23456789112346E+29, above decimal.MaxValue, which failed every Product.Query() page that held it. Every nullable decimal, double, float, int and long member of every response (not RecordID, ID or Number, and not [Required]) now reads a value that is out of range for its type, a non-numeric string, a boolean, an object or an array as null; the rest of the record and the page are kept, so paging, continuation tokens and SkippedCount are unchanged. Each response logs one warning per record kind and field (event UnreadableNumericValue 1004, under the reading resource's logger category) naming the field and at most 20 record identities (the ItemCode, otherwise the integer RecordID or ID, otherwise unknown; a Number, which can be a national identity number, is never logged) and no other record data. Every readable value, including numbers in strings and in-range exponents such as 1.5E+3, reads exactly as before, and writes are unchanged. Identity, required and non-nullable numbers still fail the read. No public API changes. v0.6.0: a customer or vendor list row whose Number is missing, null, empty, or whitespace no longer fails the whole read with DkPlusContractException. Customer.Query(), Customer.SearchAsync, Customer.Receiver.GetCustomersAsync, Purchase.Vendor.Query(), GetAllAsync, GetPageAsync and SearchAsync, and the portable IExternalErpClient Customer and Purchase.Vendor queries, now exclude such rows, log a warning (events InvalidCustomerNumber 1002 and InvalidVendorNumber 1003) naming at most 20 record IDs and no other row data, and keep paging by the unfiltered page size, as product queries already do for rows without an ItemCode; excluded customer, vendor, and product rows still advance the 50,000-record re-anchor window, so a window that ends in them no longer stops the query, and a row served again after a re-anchor is not counted twice. ToPageAsync reports the exact number of excluded rows in the new ErpPage<T>.SkippedCount, for products too. Customer.GetAsync and Purchase.Vendor.GetAsync without a Number remain a DkPlusContractException. v0.5.0: client.Customer.Query() returns the new ICustomerQuery and client.Product.Query() the new IProductQuery, typed server-side filters on top of IDkPlusQuery<T>: customers ForName, ForSalesPerson, ForCountry, ForPostalCode, ForPaymentTerm, ForPaymentMode, ForEmail, Blocked, VatExempt and Deleted (wire name, salesperson, country, zipcode, paymentterm, paymentmode, email, blocked, novat, deleted); products ForAliasItemCode, Inactive, OnWeb and Deleted (wire aliasItemCode, inactive, onweb, deleted). The client normalizes the text before sending, because DK Plus matches the customer group, name and email only in lowercase: the customer and product group (ForGroup), name, sales person, postal code, payment term, payment mode and email are sent lowercase and the country uppercase (invariant culture), and a name without * is sent as *name* (a contains search; DK Plus ignores a name without a wildcard). Live, letter country codes such as IS match no customers. Every fluent member of the new self-typed IDkPlusQuery<T, TSelf> returns the entity query, so filters, Take, Include and Exclude chain in any order. The filters are sent after the existing parameters in wire-name order, kept on every page and after a re-anchor past the 50,000-record limit, and part of the continuation-token filter hash; a blank string filter throws ArgumentException before sending, and a second call replaces the value. The casing rules and the name and alias-item-code wildcards were verified live against a DK Plus company on 2026-10-13; what Blocked(false) and Deleted(true) select is not. The new static DkPlusProjections lists, per model type, the property names Include and Exclude accept (IsSupported, IncludableProperties, ExcludableProperties; exclude-only payroll names such as SpouseName are excludable only). Callers are binary-compatible; a var reassigned from a helper that returns IDkPlusQuery<T> needs an explicit type, and only custom implementations of IDkPlusCustomerResource or IDkPlusProductResource must add the new Query() member. IExternalErpClient is unchanged. Project.DeleteAsync(number) and Project.DeleteByRecordIdAsync(recordId) delete a project through the generic table endpoint on the dkERP project table pjjob (DELETE /api/v1/general/table/pjjob?key=Number or RecordId&value=...), because DK Plus has no project delete endpoint. The maintainer confirmed that the table name and both key names work. They bypass DK Plus project validation, validate the number or record id before sending, and are never retried; what dkERP does with a project that has transactions, phases or work requests is not verified live. v0.4.2: SalesInvoiceCreateRequest.SalesPerson is now an optional string? without [Required] or the required modifier (pre-1.0, no shim). When it is null the member is left out of the invoice body and DK Plus uses the sales person of the employee linked to the API user; before, a missing salesperson was rejected before sending. v0.4.2: Breaking: VendorInvoiceApprovalRequest.ApprovalAction is now int? with [Required], and UpdateApprovalAsync validates the request before sending. A request that omits ApprovalAction (an unset property, a JSON file or a hashtable without it) is rejected with DkPlusModelValidationException naming ApprovalAction and nothing is sent; before, the missing value was silently sent as ApprovalAction 0 on a high-impact approval. Callers that assigned an int still compile; code that read the property as an int must now handle null. v0.4.0: Breaking: Contacts is removed from CustomerCreateRequest and CustomerUpdateRequest because DK Plus ignores contacts in the customer document (a create or update with contacts stored none); contacts are maintained through the new client.Customer.Contact resource (IDkPlusCustomerContactResource: GetAllAsync, GetAsync, CreateAsync with CustomerContactCreateRequest, UpdateAsync with the sparse CustomerContactUpdateRequest, DeleteAsync) over /api/v1/Customer/{customer}/Contact, validated before sending. Breaking: Receivers and Memos are removed from CustomerCreateRequest and CustomerUpdateRequest because DK Plus ignores them in the customer document (a create with receivers and memos stored neither); item receivers are maintained through the new client.Customer.Receiver resource (IDkPlusCustomerReceiverResource: GetAllAsync, GetAsync, CreateAsync with CustomerReceiverCreateRequest, UpdateAsync with the sparse CustomerReceiverUpdateRequest, DeleteAsync) over /api/v1/Customer/{customer}/Reciver, validated before sending, plus GetByNumberAsync and GetCustomersAsync over /api/v1/Reciver/{number}[/customer]; CustomerReceiver gains Customer, the owning customer returned by the receiver endpoints; customer memos have no write endpoint and are read-only. Breaking: product create and update requests take dedicated nested request types (ProductBarcodeRequest, ProductWarehouseSettingsRequest with ProductVariationRequest, ProductUnitConversionRequest, ProductVendorRequest), and vendor and product Memos take MemoPageRequest, so product and memo writes never send stock quantities, purchase history or nested Modified times; a warehouse Variations list is omitted when null instead of always being sent as []. Warehouse.UpdateProductAsync now takes ProductWarehouseSettingsRequest instead of the ProductWarehouse read model and uses the same write mapper, so PUT productwarehouse/{warehouse}/product/{product} no longer sends QuantityInStock, QuantityOnBackOrders, QuantityPoOrders, Modified or an unset Variations list. GeneralLedger.Account.CreateAsync and GeneralLedger.TaxGroup.CreateAsync now take GeneralLedgerAccountCreateRequest and GeneralLedgerTaxGroupCreateRequest instead of the GeneralLedgerAccount and GeneralLedgerTaxGroup read models and never send Modified; the account Number is validated on the request before sending. The unused ProductWarehouse and WarehouseProductVariation read models are removed. Modified is no longer filled from DK Plus ObjectDate, so Modified can now be null; ObjectDate is exposed as a separate read-only member on customer, customer transaction, vendor, product, sales invoice, order, quote, recurring sale, v2 sales line, work request and project journal (CustomerTransaction.ObjectDate is new); it is projectable with Include on customer, customer transaction, vendor, product, sales invoice, order, quote and recurring-sale queries and on work-request pages through a raw Include list, but not on v2 lines or project journals. ObjectDate is the dkPlus stored time (display label Stored Date / Vistað dags.) and Modified is the dkERP modification time; for entities whose DK Plus list response model has ObjectDate, DK Plus pages and applies modified-since, modified-after and modified-before windows on ObjectDate (otherwise on Modified), and the client only forwards the window. The XML docs of the date members, queries and filters say so. Numeric vendor transaction enum fields (all but JournalType) read as their Swagger names instead of digits. Unknown members of nested vendor approvers, dimensions, expense defaults, delivery settings, bank accounts and project phase links are kept in their own AdditionalData and written back on update. A work-request page with a raw Include list always selects both Id and Number, so every returned record can be updated or deleted. Sales quote lines (head Lines, CreateLineAsync and UpdateLineAsync) that set QuantityDelivered, OrderedQuantity, DailyRate or IndexRatio are rejected before sending, because v2 quote lines cannot store them. Work-entry updates no longer send an empty Properties object. Queries transparently continue past the DK Plus limit of 50,000 records per query: ToListAsync, AsAsyncEnumerable, ToPageAsync and the dimension, project phase, task and journal list methods restart at page 1 with modified-after set one millisecond before the newest paging timestamp (never earlier than the caller's ModifiedSince) and skip records already returned at that boundary. The paging field is fixed per entity, not per record: ObjectDate for customers, products, vendors, sales invoices, customer transactions, v2 orders, quotes, recurring sales and project journals (their DK Plus list responses have it), Modified for projects, dimensions, project phases and tasks. A query that cannot continue safely throws InvalidOperationException asking for a narrower ModifiedSince/ModifiedBefore window: no modification filter, records out of order, a full window within one millisecond, a new window that would not start after the previous one, DK Plus serving a record before the window start (it ignored the filter), or a boundary record without identity or more than 2,000 records in the boundary millisecond. Direct page methods reject page × count above 50,000 with ArgumentOutOfRangeException before sending. ToPageAsync continuation tokens are opaque (version 3): they store boundary identities only as truncated SHA-256 hashes plus timestamps and a hash of the query's filters, should not be logged, and a token from an earlier version, another record type or a query with other filters is rejected with ArgumentException. A fluent Include projection on a paged query always selects the identity and the paging field right after it (customer transactions now force Id, wire ID, and page on ObjectDate instead of Modified), and an Exclude that names either throws ArgumentException before sending, so a projected query still continues past the limit; existing include lists therefore gain ObjectDate, for example the ERPC-21 customer projection now sends include=Number,ObjectDate,VATNumber,ISATNumber,Gender,NoVat,LedgerCode, and a customer transaction Include(Text) sends include=ID,ObjectDate,Text. v2 order and recurring-sale creates with lines now work, and quote creates with lines are limited by a known DK Plus issue (below): DK Plus rejects lines in the create body, so CreateAsync posts the head without Lines, then each line to {uid}/Line in order, then re-reads the document so the result carries its lines; the whole request is validated before the first request. Once every line is stored, a failed or canceled re-read no longer fails the create: a warning is logged and the head response is returned, whose lines may be missing. If a line fails or the call is canceled, the new head is deleted and the original exception is rethrown; if that delete also fails, an AggregateException carries both and the document may remain. When the request supplies the document Number, the head is never deleted (DK Plus may have matched an existing document), and the exception's operation and message name the UId and say the head was not deleted. Known DK Plus issue: DK Plus can create a v2 quote head with Id 0 and no Number, after which its line POST fails (Assigning Null to headid!) and its delete answers Record not found!; Sales.Quote.CreateAsync with lines then sends no line and no delete and throws InvalidOperationException naming the UId and stating that the lines were not added and the head may not be deletable. v2 order, quote and recurring-sale updates with lines now apply the lines: DK Plus ignores Lines on the head PUT, so UpdateAsync sends the head without Lines, then each request line in order, PUT {uid}/Line/{sequence} for a line with a Sequence and POST {uid}/Line for a line without one; stored lines that are not listed are kept, an update that sets only Lines sends no head PUT, and Lines = [] no longer sends an empty Lines member. The head and every line are validated before the first request, and a null line is rejected as Lines[i]. Nothing is rolled back: when a line fails, the exception keeps its status, response body and correlation ID, and its operation and message name the failed line and state that the head and the earlier lines were already applied. Sales.Quote.DeleteAsync, and the compensating delete of a failed quote create, use the Swagger route DELETE /api/v2/sales/quote/api/v2/sales/quote/{uid}, because DELETE /api/v2/sales/quote/{uid} answers HTTP 405 (the new route is not yet confirmed live). The XML docs of SalesDocumentLineRequest.QuantityDelivered and OrderedQuantity state that DK Plus stores the line Quantity in both on order lines. Customer.Contact.UpdateAsync and Customer.Receiver.UpdateAsync reject a request that sets no member with ArgumentException before sending; the contact docs note that get and update by contact number did not behave as expected in a live run. v0.3.1: fixes reads that failed on 0.3.0 because DK Plus returns enum fields as numbers (customer, product, employee, product category, vendor transaction and v2 project journal reads); numeric enum values now map to their members, and an unrecognized value reads as null with the raw value kept in AdditionalData. Text enum fields read a number as its Swagger spelling, so portable Project.Status and v2 order and quote Status read InProgress instead of digits (likewise employee Status, token Type, request-log ServiceType, customer transaction RecordType, product category Type, project transaction fields, v2 Origin and project journal Status); a numeric vendor-invoice ApprovedStatus now maps to its member, and an unknown company or permission enum value reads as null instead of failing the read. v0.3.0 (breaking): every IDkPlusClient read member returns a sealed DkPlus subtype of the portable model (DkPlusCustomer, DkPlusVendor, DkPlusProduct, DkPlusProject, DkPlusEmployee, DkPlusSalesInvoice, DkPlusSalesOrder, DkPlusSalesQuote, DkPlusRecurringSale, DkPlusSalesPerson), while IExternalErpClient keeps returning the portable types. ERPC-21: VatNumber, IndustryClassificationCode, Gender, VatExempt and ReceivablesAccount are DkPlusCustomer members and are projectable with Include. Writes use one pattern per entity: a CreateRequest for the full document and a sparse UpdateRequest whose identity is the path argument; null means unchanged and an empty string is sent as written. The overloads that accepted read models, CustomerCreateRequest wrapper, Vendor.NoVat alias and SalesPersonDetails are removed. Renames include InvoiceDraft to SalesInvoiceCreateRequest, InvoiceLine to SalesInvoiceLineRequest, VendorInvoiceDraft to VendorInvoiceCreateRequest, ProjectRequest to WorkRequest (Project.WorkRequest), VendorBankAccount to BankAccount and CustomerOptions to flat DkPlusCustomer members. Swagger-enumerated fields are C# enums; unknown wire values read as null and are kept in AdditionalData. Request extension data never overrides a typed member. v1 invoice and v2 document parties reject members DK Plus cannot store before any request is sent. v2 sales documents map the contact Address, keep unknown nested party, contact, carrier and extra-details members in AdditionalData (and unknown Dimensions and Payment members in the parent's AdditionalData), type Receiver as DkPlusSalesDocumentParty, and accept DiscountAmount and a line Sequence; UpdateLineAsync copies the path sequence into the body (matching by Sequence on a head PUT is unverified live). A contact City or fourth address line, and party or contact data a v1 invoice cannot store, are rejected before sending. Raw include lists (vendor page, project and work-request lists, ledger accounts) always select the identity and exclude lists may not drop it; a read without its identity raises DkPlusContractException. Work-request updates copy the path id into the body, and non-string vendor-invoice approval status tokens read as null with the raw value retained. Vendor invoice attachments use FileAttachment and a missing name or content raises DkPlusContractException. Privacy: the employee payroll fields SpouseName, BankAccount, SalaryCode, PaymentFrequency and PaymentMode are stripped from AdditionalData on every employee read and are never written; an employee projection may Exclude them but not Include them. Employee, v1 sales invoice (Number) and v2 sales document (Id/UId) projections always include the identity and refuse to exclude it. DkPlusGender is renamed Gender and TokenUpdate is renamed TokenUpdateRequest. v2 order and quote Status (SalesDocumentStatus), order DeliveryStatus (SalesOrderDeliveryStatus, also on DkPlusSalesOrder) and project Status (ProjectStatus) are enums validated before sending. Salesperson, v2 document and project-phase create requests enforce their [Required] members before any I/O, and work-entry writes no longer send JSON null extension values. Retains the portable-read and DK-specific separation, DkPlus projections, correlation IDs and resilience behavior of earlier releases. v0.4.2: an invoice create or price-calculation request whose Customer is null (for example read from JSON) now fails with DkPlusModelValidationException before sending instead of a NullReferenceException.
title: DevOp dkPlus Client
